title: Investigating the mechanism of artemisinin in treating osteoarthritis based on bioinformatics, network pharmacology, and molecular docking.
authors: Zhu, Yifang; Li, Min; Wang, Qin; Yu, Wenjing; Zhao, Dan
one_liner_zh: 基于网络药理学和分子对接研究青蒿素治疗骨关节炎的机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study aims to explore the mechanism of artemisinin in treating osteoarthritis (OA) through bioinformatics and network pharmacology. The targets of artemisinin were obtained from databases such as TCMSP, and the disease targets of OA were screened from OMIM, TTD, DisGeNET, and GEO databases. The predicted targets of artemisinin were intersected with OA disease targets to obtain drug-disease common targets, which were visualized using a Venn diagram. Gene ontology (GO) analysis and KEGG functional analysis was performed on the 68 common target genes, and protein interaction network analysis was conducted to analyze their interaction relationships. The key genes were identified using the Cytohubba algorithm, followed by molecular docking with AutoDockTools 1.5.7 software and PyMOL software. Through database screening, 464 targets of artemisinin were identified, and 1654 OA target genes were screened from databases and GEO chip databases. The intersection of drug targets and disease targets yielded 68 drug-disease common targets. GO and KEGG analysis showed that these common target genes are mainly involved in oxidative stress response, bone formation, response to bacterial molecules, response to lipopolysaccharide, response to hypoxia, response to xenobiotic stimuli. Their molecular functions include regulation of transcription factor binding, ubiquitin-protein ligase activity, cytokine receptor binding. These common targets are enriched in 36 signaling pathways, including MAPK signaling pathway, PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, IL-17 signaling pathway, NF-Kappa B signaling pathway, which are key regulatory pathways in the development of OA. Through protein interaction analysis and Cytohubba algorithm, 10 key genes were obtained. Furthermore, the top 5 key genes (BCL-2, IL-6, CASP3, HIF1A, TNF) were molecular-docked with artemisinin, and the results showed that these molecules could form stable binding through hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interaction. Artemisinin may exert drug efficacy through multi-target and multi-pathway synergism in the treatment of OA. This study provides an effective theoretical basis for the treatment of OA with artemisinin.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过生物信息学和网络药理学探讨青蒿素治疗骨关节炎（OA）的作用机制。从TCMSP等数据库获取青蒿素的靶点，并从OMIM、TTD、DisGeNET和GEO数据库中筛选OA的疾病靶点。将青蒿素的预测靶点与OA疾病靶点取交集，获得药物-疾病共同靶点，并使用维恩图进行可视化。对68个共同靶基因进行基因本体（GO）分析和KEGG功能分析，并进行蛋白质相互作用网络分析以探讨其相互作用关系。使用Cytohubba算法识别关键基因，随后利用AutoDockTools 1.5.7软件和PyMOL软件进行分子对接。通过数据库筛选，鉴定出464个青蒿素靶点，并从数据库和GEO芯片数据库中筛选出1654个OA靶基因。药物靶点与疾病靶点的交集产生68个药物-疾病共同靶点。GO和KEGG分析显示，这些共同靶基因主要涉及氧化应激反应、骨形成、对细菌分子的反应、对脂多糖的反应、对缺氧的反应、对外源刺激的反应。其分子功能包括转录因子结合调控、泛素-蛋白连接酶活性、细胞因子受体结合。这些共同靶点富集于36条信号通路，包括MAPK信号通路、PI3K-Akt信号通路、TNF信号通路、IL-17信号通路、NF-Kappa B信号通路，这些是OA发展中的关键调控通路。通过蛋白质相互作用分析和Cytohubba算法，获得10个关键基因。进一步，将前5个关键基因（BCL-2、IL-6、CASP3、HIF1A、TNF）与青蒿素进行分子对接，结果显示这些分子可通过氢键和疏水相互作用形成稳定结合。青蒿素可能通过多靶点、多通路协同作用在治疗OA中发挥药效。本研究为青蒿素治疗OA提供了有效的理论基础。
